prompt: Which MP standing as the leader of a major party in the 2019 United Kingdom General Election was also an MP for Henley?
answer: Boris Johnson. He was the Conservative Party leader and MP for Uxbridge and South Ruislip in the 2019 general election, having previously been MP for Henley from 2001 to 2008.
